name: chat-reader-desktop
description: Reads Twitch, YouTube and TikTok chat out loud, with hotkeys that work while you’re in a game.

scripts.start: npm run sync-web && npm run fetch-ocr && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run sync-web && npm run fetch-ocr && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run sync-web && npm run fetch-ocr && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run sync-web && npm run fetch-ocr && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run sync-web && npm run fetch-ocr && electron-builder --win
